title: Beach House in Urban Island 🏖
description:
Our "beach house" is a perfect retreat during your Nashville visit. Walking distance to popular eateries, coffee shops and charming local businesses - you'll feel right at home walking around our historic neighborhood! 

Follow us on Instagram @NashBeachHouse #nashbeachhouse

Minutes from downtown, the convention center, Vanderbilt & Belmont.

The space
Our "Beach House" is a guest house located in the back of our property 1/3 acre property. There is a queen size bed in the loft (the loft is accessed via a ladder). It has a full-size bathroom and drawer sets and hangers to put your clothes. 

The beach house is around 350 square feet.  It also includes a great patio with a bistro table and chairs underneath Italian lights.

Guest access
Guests will have access to their own fenced in patio area with chairs.  There is plenty of street parking in front of our main house.
